summary: Frontend regression for the ARSHNAZ 2nd-iteration (Jan 2026) covering: suggested per-section page colors + override/none/default/popover ids, Firestore cloud sync of page colors AND folder background image across fresh browser contexts, unified page-shell layout at desktop (1400px) and mobile (390px) widths, Knowledge sidebar forgiving Persian/Arabic search + clear/Escape + title-first ranking + icon-only new-folder button, Knowledge editor confirm-before-discard + Ctrl/Cmd+S submit, and regression (search palette + /today console cleanliness, dark-mode). Logged in with test.arshnaz@example.com on http://localhost:3000 (preview Vite). ~95% of requested flows PASS. One minor gap: three listed pages (/mind, /values, /checkin) do NOT use the new page-shell class.

issues: These three pages still render without the unified `page-shell` wrapper (shellCount=0 at both 1400px and 390px). Settings, stats, kanban, calendar, buckets and life-architect correctly use it (shellCount=1, pl/pr=32px desktop / 16px mobile, pb preserved). No horizontal overflow and content remains visually acceptable, but side-padding/max-width consistency with the rest of the app is lost. If the intent of the iteration was to unify many pages under page-shell, these three were missed.

verified_flows.suggested_page_colors: PASS — /app/today <main> default bg = color(srgb 0.927 0.954 0.962) (soft sky). /app/life-architect default = color(srgb 0.952 0.936 0.958) (violet-ish). /app/calendar = sky. Dark mode toggle (header-theme-toggle) flips html.dark and tint adapts (bg becomes dark variant).
verified_flows.page_color_popover_ids: PASS — [data-testid=header-page-color-button] opens popover exposing [data-testid=page-color-rose|amber|emerald|sky|violet|slate|none]. [data-testid=page-color-default] (بازگشت به رنگ پیشنهادی) is ABSENT when there's no stored choice and APPEARS once a user has picked a color or explicit 'none' — correctly implementing the brief.
verified_flows.page_color_persistence: PASS — picking violet on /today → bg = color(srgb 0.936 0.912 0.954), persists after full reload. page-color-none → bg = rgba(0,0,0,0) and persists. page-color-default restores suggested sky.
verified_flows.cloud_sync_page_color: PASS — set emerald on /today in context 1, waited 6s. Opened a NEW browser context (fresh cookies/localStorage), logged in with same account, /today bg = color(srgb 0.895 0.942 0.910) (same emerald tint); localStorage key arshnaz_page_bg_v1_<uid> hydrated with {"today":"emerald"} from Firestore. No '[cloudState] could not upload' errors in console.
verified_flows.cloud_sync_folder_bg_image: PASS — on /app/folder/<id of پوشه آزمایشی>, triggered the file upload via [data-testid=folder-bg-file-input] (hidden input under the ⋮ menu whose menu-item id is [data-testid=folder-bg-image-upload]) with a small PNG at /root/t.png; [data-testid=folder-bg-image] rendered. Fresh context + fresh login opened the same folder URL and [data-testid=folder-bg-image] rendered again from Firestore (users/{uid}/app_state/ui_prefs). No permission/upload errors in console.
verified_flows.unified_layout_1400px: MOSTLY PASS — /settings, /stats, /kanban, /calendar, /buckets, /life-architect have exactly one `.page-shell` with pl/pr=32px, pb={80|96|112}px, no horizontal overflow, content centered inside main. /mind, /values, /checkin render without `.page-shell` (shellCount=0) — see design_issues.
verified_flows.unified_layout_390px: MOSTLY PASS — same six pages render `.page-shell` with pl/pr=16px, no overflow, pb intact. /mind, /values, /checkin again lack `.page-shell` at mobile width.

Dismiss → editor stays open. Accept → editor closes (changes discarded).
verified_flows.knowledge_editor_cancel_without_change: PASS — opening editor and immediately clicking 'انصراف' closes silently (no confirm dialog triggered).
verified_flows.knowledge_editor_ctrl_s: PASS — with a real title change, Ctrl+S triggers form submit (save button shows 'در حال ذخیره...' spinner; src/components/knowledge/KnowledgeDocumentEditorModal.tsx line 121 calls formRef.requestSubmit on (ctrl|meta)+s). Modal remains open while saving — not an error, just a save-in-progress state.
verified_flows.regression_command_palette: PASS — [data-testid=header-search-button] opens a role=dialog palette on /app/today; Escape closes it.
verified_flows.regression_today_console: PASS — no new app-level console errors on /app/today beyond the pre-existing Vite HMR 'wss://localhost' refused and the preview-only 500 for /api/arsh (both known environmental).
verified_flows.dark_mode: PASS — header-theme-toggle on /calendar flips html.dark on; main bg becomes dark variant color(srgb 0.110 0.135 0.144); toggling off restores the light sky tint.

action_items: Wrap /app/mind, /app/values and /app/checkin page content in the `page-shell` component (or add the class) so the unified side-padding and max-width match settings/stats/kanban/calendar/buckets/life-architect. Currently shellCount=0 on these three pages at both desktop and mobile widths.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/pageBackground.ts: Clean separation of 'stored' vs 'suggested' and the isDefault check (stored === null) is correct. defaultPageColor correctly groups pages into task/knowledge/mind sets. Suggestion: `tag:` composite key is handled, but ensure new /app/<x> pages added later are also classified (otherwise they'll silently fall through to null).
src/lib/uiPrefsSync.ts + src/hooks/useAuth.tsx: Cloud roundtrip from ctx1 → Firestore → ctx2 observed within ~7-8 seconds including fresh login; no permission errors. Good.

src/components/knowledge/KnowledgeDocumentEditorModal.tsx:112-128: window.confirm-based discard-guard is fine, but using a Shadcn AlertDialog instead of the native confirm would match the rest of the app's modal UX and be theme-aware; the test only verifies behavior, not UX.

src/pages/tasks/TasksHeader.tsx: `data-testid="folder-bg-image-upload"` is on the DropdownMenuItem (only present when the ⋮ menu is open) while the actual file input also has `data-testid="folder-bg-file-input"`. Both are useful; worth documenting so playbook authors use `folder-bg-file-input` for programmatic upload tests.
Unified layout: three mind-section pages (/mind, /values, /checkin) are missing the `page-shell` wrapper. Low-risk visual inconsistency.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all 7 brief items verified; 1 minor design gap on 3 pages missing page-shell

test_credentials: test.arshnaz@example.com / Test123456 (live Firebase, from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Disclaimer: role=checkbox. Submit button: 'ورود به حساب'. Onboarding dismiss: 'رد کن'.
seed_data_creation: No persistent new seed data created in this iteration. During cloud-sync testing the Firestore doc users/{uid}/app_state/ui_prefs was written with {'today':'emerald'} and the folder 'پوشه آزمایشی' bgImage was (re)set to a small 32x32 PNG — both are expected test side-effects on the already-dedicated test account. The temporary 'Beta blockersZ' title tweak on the Beta blockers knowledge doc was reverted at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite HMR 'wss://localhost' refused and /api/arsh 500 are environmental in the preview — ignore. For Firestore sync tests, always wait >=6s after a write in ctx1 and >=7s after login in ctx2 before reading the restored state. Knowledge sidebar does NOT use `[data-testid^=knowledge-doc-]`; the doc rows are plain divs with class 'space-y-0.5 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-150' wrapping the title text — scope sidebar queries by proximity to [data-testid=knowledge-search-input] instead. For folder bg upload: use [data-testid=folder-bg-file-input] directly (hidden input) rather than opening the ⋮ menu to click [data-testid=folder-bg-image-upload] (the latter is a DropdownMenuItem only mounted when menu is open). The three pages missing page-shell are /mind, /values, /checkin — the next iteration should re-check these after fix.
rca_of_issue:
/mind, /values, /checkin lacking page-shell: likely those three page components (src/pages/MindView.tsx or similar) still render their own top-level wrapper rather than the unified `
…
` used by SettingsView/StatsView/KanbanView/CalendarView/BucketsView/LifeArchitectView. A one-line class swap or wrapping in should fix it. Not a functional bug, only a visual-consistency miss.
